check_ip.description: Answer whether an address can be located at all, and say why not when it cannot: a typo, or an address in a range reserved by the IANA such as a private network or a loopback. It answers no rather than failing, so it is what to branch on before spending a step on an address someone typed in.
check_ip.display_name: Check whether an IP address can be located

mock_response.explanation: That address is in a range reserved by the IANA - a private network (10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x or fc00::/7), a loopback, a link-local, multicast or documentation address. It belongs to no network operator and has no public location. Public traffic arrives from the network's own public address instead.

check_ip.name: check_ip

description: Find out where an IP address is and who runs it, from IPWHOIS.io's free keyless endpoint. Locate one address, a list of addresses, or the address this workflow itself calls out from. Check whether a visitor is in a country you serve or inside the EU, what time it is where they are, which network and company the address belongs to, and how far away they are - along with the country's capital, dialling code, neighbours and flag. No account or API key required.
